summary.text: Patricia "Patty" Contreras is the Democratic candidate for Arizona State Senate District 12 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives from District 12, has served since January 9, 2023, and is not running for re-election to that seat in 2026.

paragraphs.text: Patricia Contreras was born in Somerton, Arizona, and lives in Phoenix.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she said she retired from the City of Phoenix after 31 years, where she worked in the Parks and Recreation and Human Services departments.
Contreras and Anastasia Travers won the two Arizona House District 12 seats in the November 2022 general election, and Contreras was re-elected in 2024.
Her House committee assignments for 2025-2026 were Health and Human Services; Natural Resources, Energy and Water; and Transportation and Infrastructure.
Contreras advanced from the Democratic primary for Senate District 12 on July 21, 2026.
In the 2022 survey, she said she would advocate for education, the environment and senior citizens.
